elaine: Quick API sync — we need a canonical scoring envelope for /rerank so routing, quotas, and dashboards can rely on a single contract. Draft below. Feedback?

elaine: ```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "score": number,            // raw model score (float)
      "score_norm": number,       // normalized 0..1 for cross-model routing
      "model_id": "string",
      "model_confidence": number,  // optional, model-provided confidence
      "token_cost": integer,     // cost units for this candidate
      "debug_tags": ["string"],
      "explain": ["term:weight"]  // optional sparse explain data
    }
  ],
  "trace_id": "string",
  "meta": { "route_hint": "low-latency|high-precision" }
}
```

sam: I like normalizing to 0..1 for routing. Two quick asks: add a candidate-level `sampled_payload_url` for sampled debug payloads (S3 link) and enforce a 16KB per-response limit for `explain`.

matt: Important: define `score_norm` exactly (min/max across model? z-score?). For routing we need deterministic semantics. Propose min/max per-model per-deployment over a rolling 7d window.

lina: UX dash concern — if `model_id` is freeform we'll fragment dashboards. Can we require `model_fingerprint` (short stable id) + human name? e.g., `redwood/reranker-v2:sha256`.

rafa: From model side: `model_confidence` can be noisy. Suggest we make it optional and add `quality_tier` enum (low/medium/high) derived by ML infra for routing fallbacks.

sam: quota mapping: we should map `token_cost` -> rerank_units. 1 rerank_unit = sum(token_cost) / 100? need ops input. Also cap candidates to 200 by default and expose per-route override in Console.

ops-bot: @eng-platform FYI deploy window for schema change: canary in prod at 22:00 UTC, full rollout 02:00 UTC.

matt: backwards compat: add header `X-Rerank-Compat: legacy|strict`. If legacy, allow older `score`-only payloads and server will synth `score_norm`. If strict, reject.

elaine: Good call. Action items:
- add `sampled_payload_url` (sam)
- define `score_norm` calc doc (matt + rafa)
- `model_fingerprint` requirement (lina)
- quota mapping proposal to finance (sam)
- payload size guardrails + explain limit 16KB (elaine)

lina: Dashboard idea: show a "model affinity" heatmap per route and a toggle to pin routing by `quality_tier`. That'll make canary rollouts more visible.

rafa: telemetry: emit histogram metric `rerank.score_norm.p50`/p90/p99 per model_id+route and sample 0.1% of candidate payloads (store for 7d). Also tag sampled traces with `sample_reason` (canary|anomaly|random).

sam: small nit — add `priority_tag` on candidate (`business_priority`) so downstream routing can do emergency bypass for critical results.

elaine: sounds consensus-y. We'll draft the formal proto today and push an open RFC. If anyone wants to pair on the `score_norm` formula ping me. :thumbsup:

matt: +1, will draft compat tests.

ops-bot: Deployment note recorded: RFC must be approved by eng-platform + infra before canary.

elaine: thanks all — leaving this thread open for comments, will convert to RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:
